description: ONE WEB PAGE read now from its URL by our web workers (a plain request, else a residential route, else a browser): its visible text (format=text, the default here) or its HTML (format=html). USE WHEN the user asks what a page says or wants its contents, e.g. a shop's policy, a spec sheet, a press page. DON'T USE for Amazon or Walmart (product, serp), for a shop's product data (web_product) or for searching the web (web_offers). RETURNS text or html, title, final_url, http_status, content_type, tier, bytes, truncated (over 5 MB), read_at. HONESTY: text types only (HTML, XML, JSON, plain text); search engines, social networks and non-public addresses are never read; a page that none of the three routes delivers is not read (nothing billed). LATENCY 1-90 SECONDS. COST paid plans: 1 credit (plain request), 4 (residential route) or 15 (read in a browser) per page delivered; a page not read is free.

format.description: text: the page's visible text; html: the page as served.

max_age_hours.description: Answer from a read of the same URL within this many hours (0-24, same price). 0 = a fresh read.

name: web_page
